setup.title: SpaceWar integration
wizard.setup.title: Initial setup
wizard.setup.intro: One time only. Better RPT checks Steam, the helper and the SpaceWar command without closing Steam.
wizard.setup.exclusions: The Steam popup, choosing a game and launching are per-session steps; they are not part of this setup.
wizard.welcome.title: What was detected
wizard.welcome.body: Review the summary and continue. Nothing changes until you choose an action.
wizard.steam.title: Steam and SpaceWar
wizard.steam.body: Better RPT uses SpaceWar (480) as the donor. Steam and SpaceWar are installed from Steam; the app only opens the installation.
wizard.steam.running: Steam is open. Paste the command in its UI; you do not need to close it.
wizard.steam.closed: Steam is closed. Automatic command installation is available.
wizard.steam.recheckHint: When the installation finishes, check the library again.
wizard.steam.nextHint: This step can stay pending; the app remains usable in guide mode.
wizard.helper.title: Stable helper
wizard.helper.body: The app copies the packaged helper to a fixed path. It needs no root and does not close Steam.
wizard.helper.active: A session is active. The helper in use is not replaced until it finishes.
wizard.helper.sourceMissing: The packaged helper is not available in this artifact. Reinstall Better RPT from the .deb or the AppImage.
wizard.helper.pathHint: The path is the same for .deb and AppImage, so the SpaceWar command stays valid.
wizard.dispatcher.title: Dispatcher command
wizard.dispatcher.body: Save the original value before pasting. Better RPT does not write Steam configuration while Steam is open.
wizard.dispatcher.saveFirst: Save the original value first so you can restore later.
wizard.dispatcher.conflict: The current command differs from the saved setup. It will not be overwritten.
wizard.dependencies.title: AppImage dependencies
wizard.dependencies.body: The AppImage uses the system GTK3, WebKit2GTK 4.1 and FUSE. Better RPT never runs root commands.
wizard.dependencies.notApplicable: Not applicable: the .deb declares these dependencies and the package manager installs them.
wizard.dependencies.fallback: If FUSE is unavailable, start the AppImage with APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1.
wizard.dependencies.preGui: If GTK3 or WebKit2GTK is missing, the AppImage never reaches this screen. Use --diagnose or the AppRun message.
wizard.verify.title: Final verification
wizard.verify.body: setup.json and diagnostics are read again. No backup is deleted.
wizard.verify.done: Everything is ready. The SpaceWar integration is verified.
wizard.verify.pending: Some steps are still pending. You can finish and return later; the app remains usable in guide mode.
wizard.verify.blocked: An external blocker remains. The app remains usable in guide mode.
wizard.verify.preserve: setup.json, backups and the last session are not deleted.
wizard.warning.noBackup: The command already points at Better RPT, but there is no copy of the original value. Automatic restore is unavailable.
wizard.repair.title: Diagnostics and repair
wizard.repair.intro: The problem is shown first. Nothing changes until you choose an action.
wizard.repair.readOnlyHint: The scan does not write configuration or delete backups.
wizard.repair.emptyHint: You can close this window or open the initial setup.
wizard.repair.noAction: This problem has no safe automatic action.
wizard.repair.footer: Changes are applied only when you choose an action.
wizard.repair.spacewarHint: Steam will open the installation. When it finishes, select Scan again.
wizard.repair.helperActive: The helper cannot be replaced while a session is active.
wizard.repair.recoverHint: Mark the session as finished and keep the last session and backups.
wizard.repair.cancelHint: You can cancel only while the session is preparing.
wizard.repair.sessionActive: The session is still active. The game and helper will not be closed.
wizard.repair.sessionActiveHint: Wait for the game to finish, or use Restore after the session ends.
wizard.repair.sessionRestore: A previous configuration can be restored.
wizard.repair.sessionOrphan: An orphan marker exists. It is restored only when a coherent backup exists.
wizard.repair.restoreHint: Restore is confirmed in the existing dialog and requires Steam to be closed.
wizard.repair.permissionsHint: Fix permissions outside Better RPT; the app does not use root.
wizard.repair.backupHint: Backups are read only. None is deleted without confirmation.
wizard.repair.dispatcherHint: Use the exact command and guide; a valid setup is never overwritten.
wizard.repair.depsHint: Copy the command and run it in your terminal. Better RPT does not use root.
wizard.repair.steamMissing: Steam is not installed; open the installation guide.
